description: List domains in the authenticated EnCirca account whose live RegyREST record has a verified future registration expiration date. Includes dates beyond one year. Excludes unknown dates and records whose expired flag conflicts with a future date. This does not prove DNS service, billing status, or renewal eligibility.

partner_id.description: ESB partner id. Optional if ENCIRCA_MCP_DEFAULT_PARTNER_ID is set.

name: list_unexpired_domains
